[SWS_PER_00546]
d
When a method of
ara::per::FileStorage
that opens or
modifies a
file
is called while the same
file
is currently open or being modified
by another method,
Persistency
shall return the error
kResourceBusy
.
c
(RS_AP_-
00128)
Files
are implicitly closed when their
ara::per::UniqueHandle
goes out of
scope, or when the
File Storage
to which they belong is closed.
